userManualModal.title: Charge Heads — How It Works
userManualModal.intro: Charge Heads define ledger-level charge components used to break down water bill demand into water charge, interest, penalty, and fees.

point1.title: Charge Head Details
point1.text: Defines Code, Name, Charge Type (Tax, Interest, Penalty, Charge, Fee) for municipal financial accounting.

point2.title: Component Classification Flags
point2.text: Tax, Penalty, and Refundable flags classify how each charge component is treated during bill computation, ledger posting, and refunds.

point3.title: Status & Tariff Integration
point3.text: Active state determines whether the charge head can be attached to active tariff rate schedules for demand generation.

userManualModal.note: Ensure charge types are accurately configured before linking charge heads to active tariff rules or billing demand logic.
